summary: Ares Core Infrastructure Fund filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of common shares for an aggregate purchase price of $767.8 million during its October 2026 monthly closing, spanning Class I, D, N and S shares. Pricing equals each class's September 30, 2026 NAV per share, expected within 20 business days. No underwriting discounts or commissions; upfront sales loads are capped at 2.0% for Class D and N and 3.5% for Class S, with none on Class I. Issuance relies on Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D or Regulation S exemption. This is routine interval-fund share issuance, not a special situation.
